messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: gpu-prefill service reported repeated container restarts on pool=node-group-3 (GPU OOM suspected). alert_id=INC-2026-0093
ryan (oncall): seeing noise on prefills, started triage. node-group-3 showing ~30 restarts in last 5m. paging maya.
maya (eng-runtime): on it — grabbing logs and kvcache metrics. can someone post a repro prompt if available?
liam (eng-sre): FYI I see kernel messages on node-8b2: 
```
[  123.456789] Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (containerd) score 987 or sacrifice child
[  123.456800] GPU OOM on device 0, cuCtxCreate failed
```
ryan (oncall): thanks liam. looks like prefill for long sessions spiking allocation. customer impact unknown yet, CS pinged.
alice (customer-success): flagged 2 customers on Dedicated with heavy long-window chats. asking if we should throttle prefill or switch to cold-model fallback.
maya (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: enable adaptive-prefetch=off for pool node-group-3 and force-kv-trim-now on affected containers. applying now.
ryan (oncall): please post commands. I can run if you want me to.
maya (eng-runtime): running:
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/gpu-prefill ADAPTIVE_PREFETCH=false --overwrite
kubectl -n inference exec -it pod/gpu-xxxx -- /bin/sh -c 'echo trim > /sys/fs/kvcache/command'
```
liam (eng-sre): rolling patch applied on 3 nodes. patch id=roll-2026-04-12-01. watching for restarts to stop.
ryan (oncall): restarts decreased from 30 -> 4 in 2m. CPU steady, memory pressure falling.
alice (customer-success): told customers we're investigating; offered temporary routing to smaller context model. one customer accepted fallback; updating ticket.
maya (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: long-session prefill combined with aggressive kv prefetch caused spike in GPU VRAM; KV cache didn't trim quickly under fragmentation leading to OOM which triggers container restarts.
liam (eng-sre): collected heap/kvcache metrics and device traces. saved to s3://redwood-ops/incident-7372468100/traces.tar.gz.
ryan (oncall): creating short runbook note: 1) if OOMs spike, toggle ADAPTIVE_PREFETCH=false 2) trigger kv trim 3) if still failing, fallback to coldmodel-route 4) page eng-runtime.
alice (customer-success): updating customers: brief summary + ETA 30m for full mitigation and config rollback once verification done.
maya (eng-runtime): will run a rolling restart of the remaining affected pods after one more minute of stability, then enable a temporary throttle on prefill length to 32k tokens.
liam (eng-sre): stability check 10m window: 0 restarts in last 6m post-mitigation. good to mark as mitigated.
ryan (oncall): switching to post-incident notes and handoff to next rotation. Handoff to night-oncall @liam at 20:00 UTC with link to traces and runbook.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: INC-2026-0093 marked as mitigated by ryan (oncall). Please follow postmortem process: fill template and tag eng-runtime + eng-sre. :thumbsup:
alice (customer-success): closing customer update: they acknowledged mitigation and want a follow-up during next biz day.
maya (eng-runtime): filing PR for a safer prefetch default and a kvcache trim hook. PR: github.com/redwood/rt/pull/4821
ryan (oncall): thanks team. moving thread to postmortem channel after notes. last_message_ts recorded.
